description: This Java class implements a command strategy for retrieving Access Control Lists (ACLs) associated with 'Thing' entities in the Eclipse Ditto framework. It handles the 'RetrieveAcl' command by extracting the ACL from a 'Thing' and generating a corresponding response with appropriate headers and entity tags.

classes.name: RetrieveAclStrategy
classes.description: Final class implementing the command strategy for retrieving ACLs of 'Thing' entities. It processes the 'RetrieveAcl' command, extracts the ACL, and formulates a response with headers and entity tags.

methods.name: RetrieveAclStrategy
methods.description: Constructor initializing the strategy with the specific command class 'RetrieveAcl'.

methods.name: doApply
methods.description: Performs the main logic to handle the 'RetrieveAcl' command: extracts the ACL, creates a response, and wraps it in a Result object.

methods.name: extractAcl
methods.description: Helper method to retrieve the AccessControlList from the 'Thing' object, if present.

methods.name: previousEntityTag
methods.description: Returns the previous entity tag for concurrency control based on the 'RetrieveAcl' command and optional previous entity.

methods.name: nextEntityTag
methods.description: Calculates the next entity tag for the 'Thing', based on its ACL.
